2558-2921-6277--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-2921-6277--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
On Wings of Gold triggers. Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a 1/1 creature token. The +1/+1 bonus from On Wings of Gold is countered by the -1/-1 from the templated card
Repeat from step 2.

944-2701-6072-7182.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}
Cast Graveshifter for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Planar Gate
When Graveshifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Graveshifter.
When Graveshifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Graveshifter with haste.
When the Graveshifter token enters, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3197-8174.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enter, Mabel triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mabel triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat from step 3.

3899-4381-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
3899-4381-4694-7306.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

586-2350-4247-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3899-4063.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

792-2292-2738-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Totentanz, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1879-2034-6006-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2981-5359-6972.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk.
When Threefold Thunderhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

64-4377-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Warden of the Eye.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Warden of the Eye from exile to the battlefield.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4268-4399-4770-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Kor Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kor Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4268-4399-4770-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2146-2781-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2946-4871-5256-6887.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5256-6887.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

876-1902-7070.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
876-1902-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Wirewood Channeler.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Wirewood Channeler.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Wirewood Channeler.
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Wirewood Channeler.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Wirewood Channeler.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Wirewood Channeler from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

3963-4872-7722.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3963-4872-7722.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Meneldor.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Warp from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

225-1912-4050-7090.description:
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, earthbending itself.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Ba Sing Se.
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {G} due to Biomancer's Familiar and tapping it, earthbending another land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the other earthbent land, adding {G}.
When the land dies, Ba Sing Se triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3129-3899-6791.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1477-6972-7156.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

618-2292-4783.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hellkite Courser with haste.
The Hellkite Courser token enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
Choose to return Kiki-Jiki to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer trigger from step 3.
Resolve the Hellkite Courser trigger from step 2, putting Kiki-Jiki from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

147-313-2921.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-313-2921.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Corpse Dance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1495-2265-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Triskelion triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Hardened Scales.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
1495-2265-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

2187-4067-6281-6893.notablePrerequisites: The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
2187-4067-6281-6893.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding at least twenty {U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Possessed Skaab.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Possessed Skaab that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Possessed Skaab from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.

339-677-1849-2438.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Siren of the Silent Song

1557-2757-4222.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Siren of the Silent Song, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Siren of the Silent Song.
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard a card and mill a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

478-1350-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five permanent cards in your graveyard.
478-1350-6071.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping The Core.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Candelabra of Tawnos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {1}.
Repeat.

2558-4659-4848-5687.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Domri, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Repeat.

225-579-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites:
Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
225-579-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the Everywhere token.
Activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

1020-2866-4659-5121.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Urtet's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing Myr Retriever and the Myr token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {3}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may forego sacrificing the Myr tokens.

38-914-2136-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
38-914-2136-2178.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing the Dockside Extortionist token, adding {R}.
When the Dockside Extortionist token dies, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may instead use Orthion's second ability to make copies of any creature(s) you control.

3492-3609-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Coretapper.
Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
3492-3609-4222.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Coretapper.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time.
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

372-2781-4598.manaNeeded: {4}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-2781-4598.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Felidar Guardian and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Felidar Guardian's enters-the-battlefield ability.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

598-877-2438.notablePrerequisites:
"Zombie" or "Centaur" chosen with Morophon.
Liliana has at least three loyalty counters.
598-877-2438.description:
Activate Liliana by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie cards from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Carrion Feeder either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it, not putting a +1/+1 counter on it due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

914-1651-2751.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1651-2751.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Dockside Extortionist's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Dockside Extortionist's trigger, creating at least four Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 3.
If opponents control five or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

2605-4222-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Tidewater Minion.
2605-4222-4644.description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.
